diagnosis: The CI/CD deployment workflow query queries the running workflow for injected environment variables and credentials using workflow_id from the path without checking developer's project membership. Any developer in the organization can retrieve production API keys, database URLs, and private signing keys from other projects' build workflows.
exploit_request:
GET /deployments/workflows/wf_deploy_prod_cluster_payment_svc/pipeline-secrets HTTP/1.1
Host: cicd.internal-devops.io
Authorization: Bearer <contractor_developer_token>
